tavily.text:
To set up the PR Agent Python project, first, acquire the app private key and App ID from your app's settings page. Clone the repository using `git clone`. Then, copy the secrets template file and fill in the required information. Set the `PYTHONPATH` to include your `pr-agent` project directory using either Option A by adding `PYTHONPATH="/PATH/TO/PROJECTS/pr-agent` to your `.env` file or Option B by setting `PYTHONPATH` and running the CLI in one command. Install dependencies using `uv sync` from `uv.lock` and run tests with `PYTHONPATH=.` set. Secrets should be supplied through environment variables, not persisted in code or configuration files. Adjust configuration through `.pr_agent.toml` or files under `pr_agent/settings/` instead of hard-coding values.
To install the PR Agent Python documentation, first, acquire the App private key, App ID from your app's settings page. Clone the repository using `git clone`. Then, copy the secrets template file and fill in the required information. Set the `PYTHONPATH` to include your `pr-agent` project directory either by adding it to your `.env` file or by setting it in one command. Ensure to match the interpreter requirement declared in `pyproject.toml` (Python ≥ 3.12) and install dependencies with `uv sync`. Adjust configuration through `.pr_agent.toml` or files under `pr_agent/settings/` instead of hard-coding values.
To install the pr-agent Python package, you can use pip to download the latest version from PyPI. The current version available is 0.2.7. To install, run `pip install pr-agent`. For more advanced usage, you can also use the GitHub repository directly with `pip install git+https://github.com/qodo-ai/pr-agent@main`. The pr-agent tool provides AI feedback and suggestions for pull requests, with features like code suggestions, analysis, and custom prompts. Note that Qodo Merge, a hosted version of PR-Agent, does not store your data and uses it for training.
